content:
Sara Chen: Quick async pulse for Q2 OKR milestone micro-scan — please drop a one-line update for your milestone: owner | shipped or slipped | blocker | next step. Need this for cross-team deps tracking. Update by EOD PST pls. TL;DR format encouraged.

Anne Kline: Model-serving — shipped canary for v2 routing (10%) ✅. Owner: @Anne Kline. Blocker: none atm. Next: monitor latency for 24h and ramp to 50% tomorrow if no regressions.

Miguel Torres: Dedicated infra — slipped. Owner: @Miguel Torres. Blocker: DB schema migration blocked by sharder compatibility; needs a small script fix and a maintenance window. Next: pairing session with @Lee Park tomorrow 09:30 PT, target finish Fri.

Lee Park: I'll take the pairing. Short-term mitigation: enable read-only fallback for legacy reads to reduce blast radius during migration. @Miguel Torres can you drop the migration branch?

Miguel Torres: branch: https://git.company/repo/branches/db-migration-q2 (PR #4821). Added notes to the ticket. :eyes:

Tom Nguyen: Embeddings pipeline — shipped embedding v3 quantization to beta customers. Owner: @Tom Nguyen. Blocker: slight perf regress on long-context tests (~10% CPU increase). Next: rollback quant levels for >64k sequences, follow-up PR later today.

Jessie Patel: Docs/Console — slipped. Rework of rollout UI deprioritized due to design bandwidth. Owner: @Jessie Patel. Blocker: design. Next: shipping temporary inline help text to Console v0.4 today to cover the gap.

Anne Kline: Heads-up — model routing canary depends on Dedicated capacity config. @Product please confirm traffic fallback policy if Dedicated quota is constrained during ramp.

product-bot: Suggested fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity < 20% then route to hosted-small variant and raise alert to product + eng.

Sara Chen: Agree with suggested fallback. Can we add that to the runbook? @Anne Kline can you open a short SR to the runbook and link it here?

Anne Kline: Done — runbook updated: https://docs.company/runbooks/okr-q2-canary-fallback (policy, alert thresholds, owner contact).

Miguel Torres: Dependency callout: analytics needs a feature flag to surface migration status to dashboards. @Tom Nguyen can you expose a TTL on the flag by EOD so they can poll?

Tom Nguyen: On it. Will add a small endpoint GET /feature-flags/db-migration-status returning {state, eta}. Will post PR link once tests pass.

Jessie Patel: Also pinging SRE — can we get an oncall watch for the canary ramp to 50%? Prefer Tue 10:00 PT.

eng-oncall: Confirmed — eng-oncall will watch the canary ramp window. Please add calendar invite and include runbook link.

Lee Park: Invite sent to eng-oncall and owners for Tue 10:00 PT.

Sara Chen: Quick summary / next steps: 
- Anne: monitor canary latency + execute ramp plan (runbook updated).
- Miguel + Lee: pair on DB migration, finish compatibility fix and run maintenance.
- Tom: expose migration flag endpoint + fix quant regress for long contexts.
- Jessie: temp docs shipped, follow-up UI once design bandwidth available.
- Product: fallback policy added to runbook.
- Eng-oncall: will watch ramp.

Please update this thread when your task completes or if ETA changes. Thanks — appreciate the quick micro-scan. :tada:
